summary: Behavior change (fix since 0.24.2): a mention label over maxLabelLength is no longer cut inside an e-mail, IBAN, phone number or URL; the split value is left out whole, so the PII shield never gets an unrecognised fragment. Labels within the limit or cut in a plain word are unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do. With 0.24.2 a value that started shortly before the cut reached the model as a plain-text fragment (max.musterm…). Now, when the token at the cut or the first after it has a digit, @ / : + _ % = # & ~ \ | or a dot inside, it is dropped with the value parts and separators before it (+49 170 1234567, DE89 3704 …); a label that is one value over the limit becomes the id. To keep the 0.24.2 cut: mentions: { serialize: { labelCut: 'grapheme' } } (contracts: canonicalMentionLabel(label, { cut: 'grapheme' }), serializeMentionMarker(m, { labelCut: 'grapheme' })). View context labels (60 code points) are cut the same way. Text stored by a 0.24.2 client keeps its cut label. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.
